results.title: Sugar prices surge to record highs; what it means for mills
results.description: Prashant Biyani, VP-Institutional Equity at Elara Securities, expects the higher realisations to translate into a significant improvement in earnings for sugar mills in the second quarter and through the rest of FY27.

results.title: Vande Mataram row: Karnataka Congress backs two-stanza decision; BJP criticises move
results.description: The Congress and BJP in Karnataka sparred over the Congress Working Committee’s decision to sing only the first two stanzas of Vande Mataram, triggering a fresh debate on patriotism and cultural heritage.

results.title: Andhra junior doctors cut stipend demand to 20%, reject government’s 3% offer
results.description: A 15% stipend revision would cost ₹87.91 crore, about 0.03% of the State Budget, striking junior doctors said, cutting their demand from 30% to 20%.

results.title: US Army eyes mobile K9 howitzer to replace M777; India too shifts towards wheeled artillery
results.description: The US Army is testing South Korea's K9 Mobile Howitzer for potential replacement of towed systems. This move aligns with India's ongoing artillery modernization efforts under its rationalization plan. India is developing indigenous systems and incorporating local content into foreign designs. Both nations seek enhanced mobility and longer-range artillery capabilities for future conflicts. This shift reflects a global recognition of modern artillery's essential requirements.

results.title: Jagadhatri set for a new beginning; Sonakshi Batra, Farman Haider and Sayantani Ghosh share their excitement
results.description: Jagadhatri, the beloved television series, is set to change its broadcast time, debuting at 10:30 PM on Zee TV starting August 24. This time shift symbolizes a promising new chapter for the captivating drama and its talented cast. The actors are filled with hope that this strategic change will foster greater viewership and accolades from fans, ensuring the show's ongoing appeal.
